sources.title: Seed 2.0 Official Launch
sources.evidence: Dated February 14, 2026; names Pro, Lite and Mini and announces API access for the full series. Establishes the original public release, separately from regional versions and later upgrades.

sources.title: Seed2.0 official model page
sources.evidence: Reopened and directly retrieved October 27, 2026. It separately labels Lite 0215 and Lite 0428 and describes the late-April addition of native audio understanding. Exact-model comparison tables contain benchmark scores, with no total/activated-parameter column. It identifies three different-sized general-purpose models but no numeric size or publicly sized base relationship for either Lite revision.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card (official homepage-linked PDF)
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full official PDF text freshly retrieved October 27 in /tmp/model130-reaudit/seed20.txt. The introduction and Lite evaluation tables distinguish three model sizes without numeric counts. Total/active/activated-parameter and lineage searches found no Lite count or sized-base mapping; parameter mentions describe example tasks rather than model weights.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full June 30 publication from the October 27 official-PDF cache /tmp/model130-reaudit/seed20_june.txt. Reviewed introduction, Lite comparisons and parameter/activation/lineage matches. Tables report capability scores and prices, not total or activated counts; generic Seed1.6/1.8 predecessor references identify no size-preserving Lite base.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full successor card from the October 27 official-PDF cache /tmp/model130-reaudit/seed21.txt. No Lite nominal total, activated-parameter comparison column or sized-base mapping was found. Parameter matches concern code examples and evaluation settings; successor capabilities are not transferred.

sources.title: ModelArk model list
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 and directly retrieved the public HTML; extracted full window._ROUTER_DATA loaderData MDContent after the web reader returned a shell. Exact seed-2-0-lite-260428 and legacy 260228 tables give capabilities and token/rate limits, with no model parameter count. Recommended replacement of Seed1.6/1.8 by Lite is a migration recommendation, not a statement of shared weights or sized-base lineage.

sources.title: ModelArk model releases
sources.evidence: Full public embedded Markdown lists seed-2-0-lite-260428 under May 2026, describing unified video, image, audio and text understanding. This regional release listing does not replace the February global launch or the official late-April upgrade timing.

sources.title: Seed2.0 official API cookbook repository
sources.evidence: Reopened the repository and directly read its current README on October 27. It identifies the Pro/Lite/Mini/Code lineup, system-level optimization and API cookbook access, but supplies no total/active count or explicit Lite lineage from a publicly sized base. Repository licensing is unchanged.

sources.title: BytePlus Service Specific Terms: ModelArk and Model Services
sources.evidence: Full public embedded Markdown defines affiliate-developed model APIs as BytePlus Model Services and grants a limited, revocable, non-transferable service license. Together with Lite API distribution, supports the descriptive proprietary classification rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: Seed2.0 official launch - current English URL
sources.evidence: Reopened and directly read October 27. The February 14 launch names Pro, Lite and Mini as models of different sizes, but gives no nominal total or active counts and no explicit mapping of Lite to a publicly sized predecessor. Performance, efficiency and pricing claims do not determine parameter size.

sources.title: Seed2.1 officially released: advancing AI productivity
sources.evidence: Reopened and directly read October 27 as a later first-party disclosure check. The release discusses model-development and agent improvements, but contains no retrospective Lite size or activated-count table and no publicly sized base relationship for the target.

name.note: Official styling is Seed2.0 Lite; the catalog spacing preserves the same name.

developer.note: ByteDance Seed announcement and provider attribution identify ByteDance.

family.note: Lite is explicitly a variant in the Seed2.0 series.

release_date.note: Explicit original launch date. The 0215/260228/260428 identifiers and BytePlus May listing represent versions or later availability, not the earliest release.

open_weights.note: Official distribution is hosted API access. The public repository is a cookbook with a model card, not a released checkpoint.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted model under service terms. The cookbook Apache-2.0 license is not a weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 English/Chinese nominal-size and named-base searches, original/current release materials, provider tables and three full cards found no developer-published Lite total or explicit sized-base relationship. February Lite and the April audio upgrade remain separately identified. Different-size positioning and replacement recommendations do not establish lineage. Null reflects missing supported nominal evidence, not a demand for an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated searches and separate original/later comparison-table review found no Lite active count or activation convention for either revision. Tables give benchmark scores, prices and token limits, not activated parameters. No total-to-active equality or sibling count is inferred.

architecture.note: The inspected cards and targeted exact-model architecture/training searches did not establish a production architecture. No dense, MoE or Transformer label is transferred from other Seed models.

context_window.note: Nominal normalization of the documented 256K context, not a separately verified exact token ceiling. The 224K input and 128K output limits are distinct.

modalities.note: Current documented Lite 0428 capabilities. February Lite supported text/visual input; audio was added by the late-April update. This undated record does not establish how every reseller alias resolves.

reasoning.note: Lite reasoning evaluations and exact-version provider deep-reasoning support establish this capability.

tool_call.note: Exact Lite 260428 row lists function calling; older Lite 260228 also lists tool use.

description.value: ByteDance Seed 2.0 model with multimodal reasoning and tool calling. The late-April 2026 Lite update added audio input.
description.note: Plain summary of documented capabilities, with revision qualification where applicable.

patch.description: ByteDance Seed 2.0 model with multimodal reasoning and tool calling. The late-April 2026 Lite update added audio input.
patch.notes: Original public launch: February 14, 2026. Audio input describes the late-April Lite 0428 upgrade, not the original February Lite; BytePlus lists the 260428 rollout under May. This undated record summarizes current documented model capabilities without verifying reseller alias routing. Context is nominal 256K, stored as 256000; an exact token ceiling is not independently established. Nominal total and active counts remain undisclosed; no publicly sized base relationship is established for either Lite revision. Production architecture remains undisclosed. The API cookbook Apache-2.0 license does not license model weights.

sources.label: Official Seed2.0 model page and Lite update

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains null total and active counts after fresh original/current release review, independent inspection of three full first-party cards, exact-version provider tables and English/Chinese count and lineage searches. February Lite and the April audio update are distinguished; no supported nominal count or sized-base mapping was found. All unrelated assessments and revision qualifications are preserved.
